segments.name: clinical communications and collaboration solutions
segments.description: Provides clinical communication and collaboration solutions, including wireless messaging and software, to hospitals, government agencies and large enterprises.
segments.evidence: We identify our business as a single segment, clinical communications and collaboration solutions, which includes operating revenues from our wireless and software solutions.

revenueModel.text: Hospitals, government agencies and large enterprises pay subscription, messaging, equipment and software fees for clinical communication and collaboration solutions.
revenueModel.evidence: We generate wireless revenue from the sales of wireless messaging services, equipment, maintenance plans and/or equipment loss protection to both one-way and two-way messaging subscribers.
